description: 한국수력원자력(주)_원자력발전소 일반현황 [nuclear facilities and electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수력원자력(주). 한국수력원자력이 공개하는 원자력발전소 호기별 일반현황 데이터입니다. 한국수력원자력㈜은 2019년부터 원자력발전소의 일반현황에 관한 자료를 공개해 왔습니다. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
